name: Komodo
background: Built a TypeScript userscript that extends Komoot with custom route tags for organizing saved tours and completed activities. It enhances Komoot route-planning pages with tag parsing, tag pill rendering, tri-state include/exclude filters, and CSS customization hooks. The project uses Vite, vite-plugin-monkey, and Bun to build the installable userscript for browser userscript managers like Tampermonkey, Greasemonkey, Violentmonkey, and ScriptCat. A VitePress documentation site turns the same README and Markdown guide content into a searchable reference with generated navigation, screenshots, troubleshooting pages, and contributor setup docs.
